metadata.description: Field-tested agent skills from real projects: frontend verification and animation capture, immersive cultural UI, Live2D / VRM avatars, Mandarin TTS, Tauri + sidecar desktop apps, LLM tool safety, and Chinese metaphysics chart reading. Every rule was measured or hit in a shipped project.

plugins.name: frontend-skills
plugins.description: Verify UI changes with evidence (screenshots across viewports, dark mode, print), record frame-exact before/after animation GIFs, and build immersive East-Asian classical pages.

plugins.name: avatar-skills
plugins.description: Live2D and VRM characters: natural procedural motion, expressions and physics, plus converting rigged 3D models to VRM 1.0 in Blender.

plugins.name: ai-app-skills
plugins.description: Building AI assistant apps: tool permissions and prompt-injection defence, Mandarin TTS text normalization and engines, and Tauri + sidecar desktop architecture.

plugins.name: mingli-skills
plugins.description: Cast BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, Western and Qi Zheng Si Yu charts and the Chinese almanac with a bundled offline script, then read strictly from the chart.
